title: usenet-ipfs-mail: crate foundation
description:
Create the usenet-ipfs-mail crate: workspace entry, Cargo.toml dependencies (axum, sqlx, rustls, usenet-ipfs-core, usenet-ipfs-reader), src/lib.rs, src/main.rs parse_args skeleton, and SQLite migration infrastructure. This is the prerequisite for all other mail sub-epics.

Why: no code can exist without a compilable crate skeleton wired into the workspace.

How to apply: all other iih sub-epics depend on this one.
